# llama31_8b_instruct: prefill-decode

B=8, input=2048, output=64; phase-vLLM runtime, BF16 KV cache, chunked prefill disabled.

This is a compact consolidation of `artifacts/debug/057_llama31_8b_instruct_b8_o64_canonical_pareto/llama31_8b_instruct`. No measurement was rerun. `data/complete_results.csv` is the machine-readable version of the full retained task-result table; empty E2E/TTFT fields mean the corresponding source recorded speedup but did not retain the raw latency in this table.
